record.category: usenet provider (German, flat rates with short article retention)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial on the price page read; the entry flat rate is EUR 12.78 a month.

retention.stated: About 35 days of article retention on the Silber flat rate, with older articles reachable by NZB file up to 600 days; the Gold flat rate is stated at up to 2 years by NZB

egress.terms: No volume limit and no speed limit on the three flat rates

record.interface_detail: NNTP with 256-bit SSL; Silber uses one server address and Gold three
record.chaining: Retention of about 35 days on the entry plan makes it a recent-article feed only; deep archives need another provider or an NZB-backed older fetch.

limits.value: about 35 days on Silber; older articles by NZB file up to 600 days

record.limits_note: Monthly: Silber EUR 12.78, Gold EUR 17.90, Platin EUR 30.17; the minimum term is one month, auto-renewing.
record.binding_note: Volume and speed are unlimited, but the entry plan keeps articles only about 35 days.

identity_cost.detail: Fees are debited from an account each period (the price page speaks of monthly debits); the order form was not opened, so its fields are unverified: behind a sign-up.

record.reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the price page read.
record.confidence_note: Prices and retention are from the vendor price page read on 2026-11-03; the page is in German.
